From: | | dokumura @ligmongroup.ca |
To: | | wrl86 @brinnholdings.ca |
Date: | | 5 October |
Subject: | | Conference |
Dear Mr. Lee, a)
As it happens, we both will be at the BPM Association Conference. I was wondering,
therefore, if we could get together over a cup of coffee. I am considering applying for a
position at Brinn Holdings and would love to learn about your experiences there. Would
11:00 work for you? I can’t make it earlier as I'll be attending the 10:00 session. If 11:00
is inconvenient, I am available in the afternoon until 3:15. As of 3:30, I'll be assisting a
colleague with her presentation (chances are you don’t know her since she joined the
Ligmon Group two weeks after you had left the company). Unfortunately, I have to leave
right after that session. Please let me know if this might be possible.
Sincerely,
David Okumura
102
